name: Store security checkup
why: Ranks store security fixes with a score and a quarterly plan, a fast start before the store lockdown skill.

name: Lock down your store logins and staff against takeover
why: Builds a sign-in policy, fix list and phishing rule sheet for a store team, matching the logins-first step in the store skill.

name: Sign-in security checker
why: Scores how staff and customers sign in and writes a password and second-step policy for the staff rules.

name: Cut risky apps and scripts from your store
why: Gives keep, swap or cut for each store app and ranks remaining scripts, the app review step in the store skill.

name: Stop fake orders, card testing and bot abuse
why: Writes fraud rules and a review routine from orders and payment set-up, for the card-testing response.

name: Fraud rules setter
why: Turns order volume and payment set-up into fraud rules and a chargeback watch, a companion to the store fraud rules step.

name: Risky order rule writer
why: Writes rules by risk level from order and chargeback numbers, useful when tuning holds after a card-testing attack.

name: Quarterly store security keeper
why: Scores staff, apps and chargebacks against last quarter, the store part of the quarterly security review.

name: Staff phishing rules briefer
why: Writes a one-page phishing rule sheet and a ten-minute drill, a short version of the awareness session skill.

name: Build a backup recovery rehearsal
why: Plans a safe restore test with an evidence log, the recovery check behind the incident plan.

name: Turn an incident into a safer procedure
why: Turns an incident timeline into a blameless report and a safer procedure, the step after an incident or tabletop.

name: Prepare a vendor security questionnaire response
why: Answers a customer's security questionnaire with evidence, once the risk register and plan exist.

name: Find leaked keys, secure them and check your live site
why: Finds leaked keys in a project and plans rotation, for stores whose payment keys sit in theme code or repositories.
